To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the combustion of composite solid propellant is controlled by the following factors in the order of importance.
the combustion of AP occurs in the gas phase, and is controlled by the rate of heat transfer from the hot gases to the surface of AP.

the burning rate of a propellant is controlled by the rate of diffusion of the oxidizer through the binder layer and that the burning rate is also affected by the rate of heat transfer from the flame zone to the binder layer.

the development of a model for predicting the burning rate of composite solid propellant, and the model is based upon the assumption that the burning process of composite propellant is the sum of the burning processes of the oxidizer, AP, and binder.

the development of the combustion models for AP, the polymer, and the propellant.
